title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode8 Now It's My Turn

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I too have a partner that I can't be without. That may be why I was able to arrive at this conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha... You saw through me. I wish you'd played dumb about it though.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But you're right, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know I'm asking for a lot right now and am having a really tough time saying this...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I still want to be Arata's partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm amazed that you figured this out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may have to do with working with you all this time. I've gotten a chance to learn quite a bit more about you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: About me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I learned from classical music that it's important to understand how the composer felt and what they were going through as they wrote a particular piece of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thus, I was able to figure out that your feelings regarding your partner lay hidden within your song, and how I felt the same way about mine...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize that you'd also made that discovery about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, and I have you to thank for that.
Anyway, what do you need me to do next?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: For now, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, I won't need any more of your help after today.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't worry about me.
Now that you know what my song's really about, I can take it from here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I mean, Aoyagi, you still have your own song to work on, right?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Remember what you said just now?
About feeling the same way as me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You finally found what you were looking for, so you should get to work while that feeling's still fresh in your mind.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Am I wrong? Isn't that also what you're thinking?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
I want to take what I'm feeling now and turn it into a song.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Good.
That means we've both made some progress.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to hearing what kind of song you end up writing, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma wishes to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Tono again. He wants that more than anything it seems...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I have a similar wish...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't possibly repay Akito for what he's given me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He was there for me when I desperately wanted to escape classical music, sing and not lose sight of who I really was.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That day...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He invited me to form a team with him.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And I was given a new dream...
To surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Our first meeting with Azusawa wasn't exactly pleasant. It was quite the opposite...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it also helped turn the four of us into one team.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, I had a chance to face Dad and take a hard look at classical music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I got to experience so many things that I never would've been able to imagine doing when I was little.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it really okay for someone with such weak resolve to stand up there with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Your resolve isn't weak.
You may think it is, but to me, you're the best singing partner a guy could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito said that I'm the best partner he could ask for.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And in order for me to keep being that incredible partner...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to keep standing shoulder-to-shoulder with him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier that Akito's been making so much progress, but it also means that I have to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can in order to make sure that I don't get left behind.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I also want to support him as best I can, so that he keeps getting better. Because I believe in him more than anybody else.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And it's not just him that I believe in now. Shiraishi and Azusawa also mean quite a lot to me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They've all been moving ahead...
Which means I don't have time to stay stuck like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (These are the feelings I care about, and I want to convey that through music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll lower the pitch here...
And try to get the melody to really ring here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can have the bass walk at a gentle pace, and give the other instruments a clearer sound. That should make things more dynamic...
A few days later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm gonna stop the demo for a second!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm, do you want to bring the tempo up a bit? I know we're trying to hold off a bit here, but it might be better to just go all out, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. That also bothered me a little.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, shall we give it a try? I'd like to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, awesome! How about you, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to try that as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's start again from the top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Haha. We just sang nonstop...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it felt really great after we decided to just sing as hard as we could for that one part instead of holding back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that felt really good for me too! And I bet it's gonna feel even better once we've finished editing our demo.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's also nearly done, correct?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we just have a few minor adjustments left to make, so it should be done by tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was sorta worried about what would happen after we all decided to make new songs, but it really ended up being worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we have you two to thank.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Next, it's my turn...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, everyone, may I have your attention for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up? Why so formal?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's not actually anything serious...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Ah, so this is how Soma and Azusawa must've felt.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This fear that you didn't do enough... That the listener won't understand the feelings you're trying to convey...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't expect it to be used during our upcoming event, but I actually made my own track...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, would it be okay if I had you three listen to it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! I really wanna hear it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The reason I wanted to sing with you is because of that look of determination you had on your face just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It tells me that there's no way you didn't give this song everything you had.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can bet on that look you just made, right? If so, Toya, let me listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is so strange. I was so worried just a second ago, but what Akito just said made that all go away.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I appreciate it.
Then, here it goes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, Aoyagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can hear each instrument so clearly, but they're working beautifully in unison. It feels so good. This must be what he meant by Aoyagi meant by achieving a good overall sound.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it doesn't stop there. You can hear all these different sounds within this incredible harmony...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The string section went nuts there just now. It was such a powerful sound, but in a way, also gentle. I felt really encouraged by it for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My chest... It's tightening up... What's going on? I really want to sing right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Argh, if only we were on stage!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did you all think...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really wanna sing this track!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It was so incredibly amazing, Aoyagi!
I really want to sing your song right now too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put it into words, but it's like this song was made for us...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, Kohane, you're totally spot on.
It's like it was lifting us up onto a stage just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both very much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did you think, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did I think? Obviously, I thought it was the best thing ever! If we were to perform this song, the sky would be the limit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just hearing the intro alone made me want to sing it, but as the song went on, I felt this hot sensation start welling up inside me. I guess that's what it really means to evoke emotions in somebody.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, where did you learn to make something like this?! This means I've gotta up my game too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is this what you've been busy with lately, Toya? Were you working on this song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. So, the truth is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, I'm supposed to keep what Soma was making a secret...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I asked someone for help when it came to actually writing this song, and I really couldn't have done it without them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, it wasn't just them. I have you to thank as well, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
While I wrote this song, I was reminded of everything that we'd gone through together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm standing here today because you discovered me singing by myself after I ran away from classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even when I wasn't sure if it was actually okay for me to be performing alongside you, Akito, you said that it was.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you hadn't, I very likely would've stepped away from music altogether.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you prevented that from happening, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I realized just how much of a privilege it is to sing alongside a partner like you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was able to put this track together because I want to keep singing with you. I want to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with you as we perform.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, you're the best partner I could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, that's my line.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Akito, are you blushing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet, you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Based on everyone's reactions, it seems I was able to convey my thoughts and feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As bad as I feel for making them wait so long, I'm glad I was able to accomplish that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we have to play this song during next week's event. I'll let Tono and the others know later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, we're also going to perform this song...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I want us to practice a bit more in order to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we really don't have much time left until the event. Practicing two new songs sounds awfully difficult...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, I'm sure we'll manage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, that shouldn't be a problem for us whatsoever. Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! I don't care how hard we have to practice. I want to sing your song just that much, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There you have it.
We aren't about to let a good track go to waste. Not when it's dangling in front of us like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for my track... I'm gonna need a little bit more time, and I'll do my best to not change our individual parts. In any case, I've got a good feeling about how it's gonna turn out now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No matter how I look at it, this isn't going to be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, we were really motivated, but we went a bit overboard sometimes. Looking back, I'm sorta amazed at how much we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But going overboard can sometimes be a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's make this the best event ever, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
